commands.author: Monkey-wusky

target.title: fix(infra): use Buffer.byteLength for JSON string byte-limit fast-path guard
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`jsonStringByteLengthUpToLimit` used `value.length` (UTF-16 code units) as a fast-path estimate. For CJK text this underestimates UTF-8 byte count by up to 3x, so the guard incorrectly passes strings that should bail early — triggering unnecessary `JSON.stringify` allocations.

The first fix (#106402 original) replaced the guard entirely with `Buffer.byteLength`, which fixed CJK accuracy but made oversized ASCII strings perform an O(n) scan instead of the original O(1) bailout.

This revision preserves both: the O(1) lower-bound guard catches clearly oversized strings instantly, then the O(n) UTF-8 guard catches the remaining CJK/emoji cases.

## Why This Change Was Made

Two-layer guard:

1. `value.length + 2 > remainingBytes` — O(1), catches oversized ASCII immediately
2. `Buffer.byteLength(value, "utf8") + 2 > remainingBytes` — O(n), catches CJK/emoji that passed the first guard
3. `jsonUtf8BytesOrInfinity(value)` — fallback, accurate but expensive

ASCII behaviour is unchanged (`byteLength == length` for ASCII, so both guards agree). CJK strings that pass the O(1) guard still get the accurate UTF-8 check.

## User Impact

- No behavioural change for callers (`session-tool-result-guard`, `worker-environments/inference`, `tool-result-middleware`)
- Oversized ASCII bailout restored to O(1)
- CJK strings correctly bail without JSON.stringify allocation

## Evidence

**Two-layer guard correctness** (all three scenarios produce identical results):

```
Oversized ASCII (50k chars, budget 8192):
  O(1) guard: 50_002 > budget → bail immediately
  result: { bytes: 8193, complete: false }  ← same as before

CJK content (3k 中 chars, budget 8192):
  O(1) guard: 3_002 ≯ 8_183 → falls through
  O(n) guard: 9_002 > 8_183 → bail
  result: { bytes: 8193, complete: false }  ← same as before

Fitting strings:
  Both guards pass → jsonUtf8BytesOrInfinity → accurate count
```

**Unit tests**:

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/json-utf8-bytes.test.ts \
  src/agents/session-tool-result-guard.test.ts \
  src/gateway/worker-environments/inference.test.ts \
  src/agents/harness/tool-result-middleware.test.ts
```

```
Test Files  6 passed (6)
     Tests  106 passed (106)
```

Three new regression tests:
- CJK bailout: 3,000 `"中"` chars pass O(1) guard, caught by Buffer.byteLength
- ASCII fast-path: 50,000 `"x"` chars bail at O(1) guard
- Unicode under limit: emoji strings within budget complete accurately

**Diff**: 2 files, +22/-3. No pnpm-lock.yaml. Branch from upstream/main.

AI-assisted.
